title: The Extreme Points of Mean-Preserving Contractions
title_primary: The Extreme Points of Mean-Preserving Contractions
authors: Andreas Kleiner, Benny Moldovanu, Philipp Strack, Mark Whitmeyer
official: 官方在线 2026-09-11 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We study multidimensional mean-preserving contractions (MPC) and their extreme points. Proposition 1 focuses on extreme MPCs of a measure μ: each finitely supported extreme MPC ν induces a partition of X, the domain of μ, into convex sets such that the support of ν on each element of the partition is an affinely independent set, and such that the restriction of ν on each element of the partition is itself an MPC of the restriction of the prior μ on that element. We apply our results to several questions concerning moment persuasion and categorization. In particular, we prove that categories and prototypes (key elements typically assumed to be exogenous in the classical literature on categorization) can endogenously emerge as outcomes of optimization when the decision maker faces limits on the amount of information that she can either acquire or process.

title: How Does carbon emissions trading policy affect green poverty reduction? Evidence from China’s pilot quasi-natural experiment

official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-26 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Green poverty reduction, which integrates green development and poverty reduction, has become a vital foundation for long-term regional development. Given China’s role as the world’s largest emitter and its ongoing transition, the carbon emissions trading policy has a significant impact on regional environmental improvement and economic development. However, its effects on green poverty reduction in China remain underexplored. This study calculates the green poverty reduction index and investigates the influence of the carbon emissions trading policy on green poverty reduction by applying the difference-in-differences model using provincial data of China from 2006 to 2022. The results demonstrate that: (1) the carbon emissions trading policy significantly promotes regional green poverty reduction; (2) the heterogeneity analysis shows that this positive effect varies across allocation of carbon emission quotas modes, geographical locations and the degree of carbon trading market effectiveness; (3) the mechanism analysis identifies that improving green innovation efficiency and reducing fiscal decentralization are two critical channels through which carbon emissions trading policy to affects green poverty reduction. These findings provide empirical evidence for optimizing carbon market mechanisms to promote green poverty reduction more effectively, and offering practical insights for improving policy design and regional sustainable development strategies. KEYWORDS: Carbon emissions trading policy green poverty reduction difference-in-differences model green innovation efficiency fiscal decentralization JEL CLASSIFICATION: O44 O13 R11 Q48

authors: Arjada Bardhi, Yingni Guo, Bruno Strulovici
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-17 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Do workers from social groups with comparable productivity distributions obtain comparable lifetime earnings? We study how a small amount of early-career discrimination propagates over time when workers’ productivity is revealed through employment. In breakdown learning environments that primarily track on-the-job failures, such discrimination spirals into a substantial lifetime earnings gap for groups of comparable productivity, whereas in breakthrough learning environments that track successes, early-career discrimination can be self-corrected, so comparable groups obtain comparable lifetime earnings. This contrast persists in large labor markets and with flexible wages, inconclusive learning, and misspecified employer beliefs.

source: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
official: 官方在线 2026-07-29 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We use recent cross‐country experiences to assess the impact of shrinking central bank balance sheets through quantitative tightening (QT). QT announcements increase government bond yields, steepening the yield curve and potentially signaling a greater commitment to raising policy interest rates, but have more limited effects on most other financial market indicators. Active QT has a larger impact than passive QT, particularly on longer maturities. Increased demand by domestic nonbanks has largely compensated for reduced central bank bond holdings. Overall, QT has (to date) had more of an impact than “paint drying,” but far less than simply reversing the effects of quantitative easing programs.
abstract_zh: 我们利用近期跨国经验评估了通过量化紧缩（QT）缩减央行资产负债表的影响。QT公告推高了政府债券收益率，使收益率曲线陡峭化，并可能释放出更坚定加息的政策承诺信号，但对大多数其他金融市场指标的影响较为有限。主动型QT比被动型QT影响更大，尤其在长期限债券方面。国内非银行机构需求的增加在很大程度上弥补了央行债券持有量的减少。总体而言，QT（迄今为止）的影响远非“乏善可陈”，但远未达到简单逆转量化宽松政策效果的程度。

title_zh: 灵活关怀？工作条件与成人照护供给
title_primary: 灵活关怀？工作条件与成人照护供给

authors: Costa-i-Font, Joan, Wang, Wanying
official: 官方在线 2026-07-27 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Although flexible employment policies can help employed individuals balance caregiving and paid work, limited evidence has been devoted to examining the effect of working flexibly on the supply of care to older adults. In this paper, we study the impact of flexible working conditions on the supply of informal adult care and mental health. We exploit variation from the 2014 expansion of the Right to Request Flexible Work (RRFW) to employees in the UK. Our findings point to a gendered response to increased employment flexibility. We document a 1.3-percentage-point increase in the likelihood that men provide informal care within the household, alongside less regular daytime work, greater control over working hours, and higher engagement in home production. In contrast, among potential female caregivers, we find that the reform reduced the probability of high-intensity caregiving, which is typically incompatible with employment or related activities. We document that the increased workplace flexibility not only encourages caregiving but also helps reduce gender disparities in unpaid care. We additionally find suggestive evidence of improved mental health outcomes, particularly among men.
abstract_zh: 尽管弹性就业政策有助于在职人员平衡照护责任与有偿工作，但关于弹性工作安排对老年人照护供给影响的实证证据仍然有限。本文研究了弹性工作条件对非正式成人照护供给及心理健康的影响。我们利用2014年英国《弹性工作请求权利》（RRFW）扩展至雇员的政策变动作为识别策略。研究结果揭示了就业弹性增加带来的性别差异化反应。我们发现，男性在家庭内提供非正式照护的可能性上升了1.3个百分点，同时其常规日间工作时间减少、对工作时间的掌控力增强，且参与家庭生产的程度提高。相比之下，在潜在的女性照护者群体中，该改革降低了高强度照护的概率，而高强度照护通常与就业或相关活动难以兼容。我们进一步发现，工作场所弹性的增加不仅促进了照护供给，还有助于缩小无偿照护中的性别差距。此外，我们还发现了心理健康状况改善的初步证据，尤其是在男性群体中。

authors: Advisory Board, Serdar Birinci, Loukas Karabarbounis, Kurt See, Francesco Agostinelli 等
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Models to explain the chances of economic activity, employment and full-time work in a national cross-section of British women in 1980 in terms of a number of demographic and economic variables are estimated by OLS. Marital status differentials are minor once the presence of dependent children and the level of alternative income are controlled. Earning power is also an important factor; it is imputed on the basis of work history information at the level of pay associated with the best paying occupation, not necessarily that current or most recent, on the grounds that mature women workers are often over-qualified for the jobs with which they combine domestic responsibilities. Regional variations, remote childbearing and marital history, and fertility intentions have little or no explanatory power. Participation rates among women who are neither students nor permanently sick are also reduced by responsibility for adult dependents, being married to a non-earning husband and living in an area of high unemployment. Through the last two factors adverse demand conditions reduce both the chances of women having jobs, and to a smaller extent, of married women describing themselves as economically active.
abstract_zh: 本文利用1980年英国全国横截面数据，通过普通最小二乘法（OLS）估计了若干人口与经济变量对女性经济活动、就业及全职工作概率的解释模型。在控制受抚养子女存在及替代收入水平后，婚姻状况差异的影响微乎其微。收入能力同样是重要因素——基于工作历史信息，以与最高薪酬职业（而非当前或最近职业）对应的薪资水平进行归因，理由是成熟女性劳动者往往因兼顾家庭责任而从事与其资质不符的工作。区域差异、生育间隔与婚姻史、生育意愿的解释力较弱或可忽略。既非学生亦非长期病患的女性，其劳动参与率还会因以下因素降低：需照料成年受抚养人、配偶无收入、居住在高失业率地区。通过后两个因素，不利需求条件既降低了女性获得工作的概率，也在较小程度上降低了已婚女性自评为经济活动人口的概率。

official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-17 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We propose a quantitative spatial model featuring heterogeneous worker groups and their travel to consume nontradable goods and services. We consider the opening of the Downtown Line in Singapore, which connected regions where high-income households have residential amenities to where nontraded sectors are productive. Leveraging transit farecard data, we show that high-income workers saw large welfare gains but low-income workers gained little. Everyone enjoyed improved access to consumption opportunities, but low-income jobs in nontradables moved to less attractive workplaces. Abstracting from consumption travel understates the disparate impact across worker groups threefold.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个包含异质性工人群体及其通勤消费非贸易商品与服务的定量空间模型。以新加坡市区线的开通为研究对象，该线路将高收入家庭享有居住便利性的区域与非贸易部门具有生产优势的区域相连接。基于交通票务数据，我们发现高收入工人获得了显著的福利提升，而低收入工人获益甚微。所有群体均享受到消费机会改善，但非贸易部门的低收入岗位转移至吸引力较低的工作场所。若忽略消费通勤因素，不同工人群体间的差异化影响将被低估三倍。

title: Mind the KF* Gap: EME Vulnerabilities to Global Shocks
title_zh: 注意KF*缺口：新兴市场经济体对全球冲击的脆弱性
title_primary: 注意KF*缺口：新兴市场经济体对全球冲击的脆弱性
title_secondary: Mind the KF* Gap: EME Vulnerabilities to Global Shocks
authors: John D. Burger, Francis E. Warnock, Veronica Cacdac Warnock
official: 官方在线 2026-07-13 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Emerging market economies (EMEs) have historically been vulnerable to external shocks. Recently the global economy has experienced several major shocks yet EMEs have been remarkably resilient. Some of this improved performance can be attributed to prudent policies and stronger economic fundamentals, but the existing literature points to an overperformance mystery by some EMEs with weaker fundamentals. We evaluate an alternative measure of vulnerability based on the concept of a natural level of capital flows (KF*). Specifically, we hypothesize that EMEs are more vulnerable when prior to a large global shock capital flows—portfolio inflows, to be specific—exceed KF*. Results indicate that for major global shocks over the past two decades the pre-shock gap between actual portfolio and KF* has substantial predictive power for the post-shock performance of EMEs.
abstract_zh: 新兴市场经济体（EMEs）历来易受外部冲击影响。近年来全球经济经历多次重大冲击，但新兴市场经济体展现出显著韧性。这种表现的改善部分可归因于审慎的政策和更坚实的经济基本面，但现有文献指出，部分基本面较弱的新兴市场经济体存在"表现超常之谜"。我们基于资本流动自然水平（KF*）概念，评估了一种替代性脆弱性指标。具体而言，我们假设当重大全球冲击发生前，资本流动（特别是证券投资流入）超过KF*时，新兴市场经济体将更为脆弱。研究结果表明，过去二十年间的重大全球冲击中，冲击前实际证券投资与KF*之间的缺口，对新兴市场经济体冲击后的表现具有显著预测能力。

title: Trade Sophistication and Economic Development Stages in the Context of Global Digitalization
title_zh: 全球数字化背景下的贸易复杂度与经济发展阶段
title_primary: 全球数字化背景下的贸易复杂度与经济发展阶段
title_secondary: Trade Sophistication and Economic Development Stages in the Context of Global Digitalization
authors: Kim Hanh Nguyen, Anna Strutt, Mark J. Holmes, Steven Lim
official: 官方在线 2026-07-11 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This study aims to explore the relationship between trade sophistication and economic development stages, including in the context of digitalization. We employ nonparametric, semiparametric, and parametric methods, covering the period from 2003 to 2024 across 119 countries, categorized into three income groups. Our findings show that GDP per capita has a positive but diminishing relationship with export and import sophistication, suggesting that trade sophistication grows rapidly at lower levels of economic development but slows down as economies become more economically advanced. The evolution patterns of export and import sophistication are relatively similar throughout the stages of economic development; however, the level of export sophistication consistently exceeds that of import sophistication across all income groups. In the context of digital transformation, digitalization is found to positively affect trade sophistication in high and middle‐income countries, while GDP per capita remains positively associated with trade sophistication, but with diminishing marginal effects. For low‐income countries, GDP per capita is the primary driver of increased trade sophistication, while in high‐income countries, digitalization stands out as the dominant factor. These findings remain robust after controlling for human capital, FDI, and institutional quality, highlighting the importance of formulating stage‐specific economic policies to enhance trade sophistication in the rapidly evolving digital era.
abstract_zh: 摘要 本研究旨在探讨贸易复杂度与经济发展阶段之间的关系，并纳入数字化背景进行分析。我们采用非参数、半参数及参数方法，覆盖2003年至2024年间119个国家，并将其划分为三个收入组别。研究结果表明，人均GDP与出口及进口复杂度呈正向但边际递减的关系，即贸易复杂度在经济发展水平较低阶段增长较快，但随着经济体日趋成熟而增速放缓。出口与进口复杂度的演变模式在经济发展各阶段相对相似；然而，在所有收入组别中，出口复杂度水平始终高于进口复杂度。在数字化转型背景下，数字化对高收入及中等收入国家的贸易复杂度具有正向影响，而人均GDP仍与贸易复杂度保持正向关联，但边际效应递减。对于低收入国家，人均GDP是提升贸易复杂度的主要驱动力；而在高收入国家，数字化则成为主导因素。在控制人力资本、外商直接投资及制度质量后，上述结论依然稳健，凸显了在快速演变的数字时代制定分阶段经济政策以提升贸易复杂度的重要性。

title: Quota regulation under corruption – Grand, petty and the cut-money culture
title_zh: 腐败下的配额管制——大额、小额腐败与“抽成”文化
title_primary: 腐败下的配额管制——大额、小额腐败与“抽成”文化
title_secondary: Quota regulation under corruption – Grand, petty and the cut-money culture
authors: Ayushi Choudhary, Rupayan Pal
source: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-03 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper examines the implications of different forms of corruption, i.e., grand corruption, petty corruption, and cut-money culture, on the formulation and enforcement of regulatory policies. Focusing on quota regulation in the context of natural resource extraction, it demonstrates the following. In the absence of cut-money culture, petty corruption never occurs in equilibrium, irrespective of whether the policymaker is honest or corrupt. However, when the policymaker is corrupt, the threat of petty corruption leaves no room for grand corruption unless net environmental damage due to extraction is sufficiently discounted, in which case grand corruption occurs. In contrast, the presence of cut-money culture induces corruption, either petty or both grand and petty, in equilibrium. Cut-money culture may reduce the equilibrium quota from the ‘no petty corruption enforcing quota’; however, whenever this occurs, total extraction and environmental damage rise, and welfare declines. Our results have important implications for designing corruption control mechanisms and governing natural resource extraction.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了不同形式的腐败——即重大腐败、轻微腐败及“截留资金”文化——对监管政策制定与执行的影响。聚焦于自然资源开采背景下的配额监管，本文论证如下：在缺乏“截留资金”文化的情况下，无论政策制定者是否廉洁，均衡状态下均不会出现轻微腐败。然而，当政策制定者腐败时，除非开采造成的净环境损害被充分折现，否则轻微腐败的威胁使得重大腐败无隙可乘；在此折现条件下，重大腐败则会发生。相反，“截留资金”文化的存在会在均衡中诱发腐败，无论是轻微腐败还是重大与轻微腐败并存。这种文化可能将均衡配额降至“无轻微腐败执行配额”之下；然而，每当这种情况发生时，总开采量与环境损害上升，社会福利下降。我们的研究结果对设计反腐败控制机制及管理自然资源开采具有重要意义。

title: Uncovering the choreography of life: the impact of life transitions on gendered housework patterns
title_zh: 揭示生活编排：生命转折对性别化家务模式的影响
title_primary: 揭示生活编排：生命转折对性别化家务模式的影响
title_secondary: Uncovering the choreography of life: the impact of life transitions on gendered housework patterns
authors: Pia Molitor, Mara Rebaudo, Miriam Rehm
official: 官方在线 2026-06-22 · 来源：RSS
abstract: In this paper, we investigate changes in time allocated to routine housework around four life events – cohabitation, marriage, first birth, and divorce – to explore the influence of social norms on gendered housework patterns. Using data from the German Socio‐Economic Panel (1991–2019), a timing‐based event study design reveals that gender differences intensify with cohabitation and parenthood. Women's housework hours increase significantly with the first child, while men's decrease. Marriage has no additional impact beyond cohabitation, and divorce leads to a rise in men's and a reduction in women's housework. Couples with higher‐earning women and those in East Germany show weaker adherence to these social roles.
abstract_zh: 本文通过考察同居、结婚、生育第一个子女和离婚四个人生事件前后日常家务劳动时间的变化，探究社会规范对性别化家务分工模式的影响。基于德国社会经济面板数据（1991-2019年）的时间事件研究设计显示，性别差异在同居和成为父母后加剧。女性家务劳动时间在生育第一个子女后显著增加，而男性则减少。婚姻对家务时间的影响未超出同居效应，离婚则导致男性家务时间上升、女性家务时间下降。女性收入较高的夫妻以及东德地区的夫妻，对社会角色的遵循程度较弱。

title: Corruption as a political control device: Enforceable vulnerability and coalition breakdown
title_zh: 作为政治控制手段的腐败：可强制执行的脆弱性与联盟瓦解
title_primary: 作为政治控制手段的腐败：可强制执行的脆弱性与联盟瓦解
title_secondary: Corruption as a political control device: Enforceable vulnerability and coalition breakdown
authors: Xiaodong Zhang
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-10 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper develops a political economy model in which corruption enhances political control by generating enforceable vulnerability. We conceptualize corruption as a “hostage technology”: by allowing officials to accumulate incriminating evidence, the ruler ensures that elites remain strategically fragmented and vulnerable to selective punishment. We formalize this mechanism through a coordination game of political challenge and derive a risk-dominance threshold for coalition formation. A central theoretical result is the non-monotone effectiveness of enforcement: while moderate enforcement deters political challenges, excessively strong enforcement can paradoxically undermine political control by eliminating the very leverage — incriminating evidence — needed to discipline elites. The model yields sharp comparative statics linking tolerated corruption, enforcement capacity, monitoring technology, and political threat, providing a unified theoretical explanation for the coexistence of systemic corruption and durable political stability.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个政治经济学模型，其中腐败通过生成可执行的脆弱性来增强政治控制。我们将腐败概念化为一种“人质技术”：通过允许官员积累罪证，统治者确保精英阶层保持战略上的分裂状态，并易受选择性惩罚的影响。我们通过一个政治挑战的协调博弈来形式化这一机制，并推导出联盟形成的风险主导阈值。一个核心理论结果是执法效果的非单调性：适度的执法能威慑政治挑战，而过强的执法却可能适得其反，削弱政治控制——因为它消除了用以约束精英所需的杠杆，即罪证。该模型得出了尖锐的比较静态分析，将容忍的腐败、执法能力、监控技术与政治威胁联系起来，为系统性腐败与持久政治稳定并存提供了统一的理论解释。

title: Tax Policy and Farm Organization
title_zh: 税收政策与农业组织
title_primary: 税收政策与农业组织
title_secondary: Tax Policy and Farm Organization
authors: Tia M. McDonald, Katherine Lacy
official: 官方在线 2026-06-04 · 来源：RSS
abstract: The Tax Cuts and Jobs Act (TCJA) introduced substantial changes to the tax code, affecting farms' organizational incentives. This study examines farms' responses to the TCJA along extensive and intensive margins, focusing on organizational and labor expense adjustments. Using a logit regression, we analyze the likelihood of organizational structure selection for tax purposes in response to the TCJA and the Qualified Business Income Deduction (QBID). We find farms are more likely to be organized as S corporations after the TCJA. Furthermore, using a fuzzy regression discontinuity design, we demonstrate a significant increase in wage expenses in response to QBID income limits.
abstract_zh: 《减税与就业法案》（TCJA）对税法进行了重大调整，影响了农场的组织激励。本研究从广延边际和集约边际两个维度考察了农场对TCJA的响应，重点关注组织结构和劳动费用调整。通过使用逻辑回归分析，我们探讨了农场在TCJA及合格经营所得扣除（QBID）背景下，出于税收目的选择组织结构的可能性。研究发现，TCJA实施后，农场更倾向于采用S公司形式组织。此外，利用模糊断点回归设计，我们证明了工资费用对QBID收入限额的显著增加响应。

title: Spatial linkages and the uneven effects of a commodity boom
title_zh: 空间关联与大宗商品繁荣的非均衡效应
title_primary: 空间关联与大宗商品繁荣的非均衡效应
title_secondary: Spatial linkages and the uneven effects of a commodity boom
authors: Felipe Benguria, Felipe Saffie, Shihangyin Zhang
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-03 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We study the uneven effects of a commodity cycle, documenting its impact across workers based on their skill level and the region where they live. To this end, we develop a dynamic quantitative model of a multi-region economy featuring spatial linkages (interregional trade and migration) and downward wage rigidity. Empirically, we focus on Brazil’s experience during the commodity boom of the 2000s and subsequent bust of the 2010s. The skill premium falls during the boom, while the extent of downward wage rigidity determines whether it reverts or maintains its decline during the bust. In addition, there is substantial heterogeneity across Brazilian states in the gains from the commodity cycle. Finally, we build counterfactuals to show that both spatial linkages (interregional migration and interregional trade) and downward wage rigidity jointly shape the impact of the commodity cycle on the skill premium, real wages, unemployment, and spatial disparities.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了大宗商品周期的不均衡影响，记录了其对不同技能水平和居住地区工人的作用。为此，我们构建了一个包含空间联系（区域间贸易与迁移）和工资下行刚性的多区域经济动态量化模型。实证上，我们聚焦于巴西在2000年代大宗商品繁荣及2010年代随之而来的衰退期间的经历。技能溢价在繁荣期下降，而工资下行刚性的程度决定了其在衰退期是回升还是维持下降。此外，巴西各州在大宗商品周期中的收益存在显著异质性。最后，我们通过反事实分析表明，空间联系（区域间迁移与区域间贸易）和工资下行刚性共同塑造了大宗商品周期对技能溢价、实际工资、失业率及空间差异的影响。

title: School quality beyond test scores: The role of schools in shaping educational outcomes
title_zh: 超越考试成绩的学校质量：学校在塑造教育成果中的作用
title_primary: 超越考试成绩的学校质量：学校在塑造教育成果中的作用
title_secondary: School quality beyond test scores: The role of schools in shaping educational outcomes
authors: Annalisa Loviglio
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-09 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: I study how schools affect student performance and attainment throughout secondary education. I develop a dynamic structural model of cognitive skill accumulation and educational decisions in which students have imperfect information about their ability and learn about it from academic evaluations. The estimation relies on administrative data covering the universe of students in public middle schools in Barcelona (Spain). I use the estimated model to simulate the educational outcomes that each student would achieve in every school in the sample. The results show that school quality cannot be adequately summarized by any single ranking: students with differing characteristics and ability levels benefit from different school inputs, and the school environment is particularly important for the educational attainment of students from disadvantaged backgrounds or with lower ability. In particular, the schools that would maximize these students’ final test scores are often not those that maximize their probability of graduating or pursuing further education. These findings suggest that evaluating schools using only standardized assessments may fail to identify the schools that best support disadvantaged students. I then evaluate a counterfactual policy requiring students to remain in school through the final grade and take the final assessment rather than only until they turn sixteen. The policy substantially increases graduation rates, especially among disadvantaged students, while having only modest effects on the skill composition of high school entrants.
abstract_zh: 我研究了学校如何影响学生在整个中学阶段的表现与学业成就。我构建了一个认知技能积累与教育决策的动态结构模型，其中学生对其自身能力存在不完全信息，并通过学业评价来了解自身能力。估计所依赖的数据涵盖了西班牙巴塞罗那公立初中全体学生的行政记录。我利用估计出的模型，模拟了样本中每所学校中每位学生本可取得的教育成果。结果显示，学校质量无法通过任何单一排名得到充分概括：具有不同特征和能力水平的学生受益于不同的学校投入，而学校环境对来自弱势背景或能力较低学生的学业成就尤为重要。特别是，能够最大化这些学生最终考试成绩的学校，往往并非那些能最大化其毕业或继续深造概率的学校。这些发现表明，仅使用标准化评估来评价学校，可能无法识别出最能支持弱势学生的学校。随后，我评估了一项反事实政策，即要求学生必须在校学习至最后一年级并参加最终评估，而非仅学习至年满十六岁。该政策显著提高了毕业率，尤其是对弱势学生而言，同时仅对高中入学者的技能构成产生适度影响。

title: The effects of induced emotions on punishment and reward
title_zh: 诱导情绪对惩罚与奖励的影响
title_primary: 诱导情绪对惩罚与奖励的影响
title_secondary: The effects of induced emotions on punishment and reward
authors: Michalis Drouvelis, Brit Grosskopf
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-04-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: The ability to punish free-riders has been shown to sustain cooperation in social dilemma games. Those that engage in costly punishment are often those that are angry at observed contributions of their fellow group members. This paper abstracts from the effect of integral (i.e., related to the situation) emotions and explicitly studies the effect of incidental (i.e., unrelated to the situation) emotions. By inducing either positive or negative emotions we can causally investigate the effect of negative emotions on punishment or reward decisions in a one-shot public good game where personal and social interests are at odds. Our findings suggest that neither punishment nor reward per se are a function of induced (incidental) emotions. Induced emotions also do not have an effect on the probability to punish or reward. However, we find that conditionally on punishing, subjects that are induced to be in a negative mood punish group members significantly harsher than subjects who are induced to be in a positive mood. The handing out of rewards is not affected by induced moods.
abstract_zh: 惩罚搭便车者的能力已被证明能在社会困境博弈中维持合作。实施代价高昂的惩罚的人往往是那些对群体成员观察到的贡献感到愤怒的人。本文抽象出整体性（即与情境相关）情绪的影响，并明确研究附带性（即与情境无关）情绪的作用。通过诱导正面或负面情绪，我们可以在个人利益与社会利益相冲突的一次性公共品博弈中，因果性地考察负面情绪对惩罚或奖励决策的影响。我们的研究结果表明，惩罚或奖励本身并非诱导性（附带性）情绪的函数。诱导情绪对惩罚或奖励的概率也没有影响。然而，我们发现，在条件于惩罚的情况下，被诱导处于负面情绪的受试者对其群体成员的惩罚显著严厉于被诱导处于正面情绪的受试者。奖励的发放不受诱导情绪的影响。

title: How Do Rising U.S. Interest Rates Affect Emerging and Developing Economies? It Depends
title_zh: 美国利率上升如何影响新兴和发展中经济体？视情况而定
title_primary: 美国利率上升如何影响新兴和发展中经济体？视情况而定
title_secondary: How Do Rising U.S. Interest Rates Affect Emerging and Developing Economies? It Depends
authors: Carlos Arteta, Steven Kamin, Franz U. Ruch
source: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
official: 官方在线 2025-11-12 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper examines the implications of different types of interest rate shocks in the United States for emerging market and developing economies (EMDEs). We first classify changes in U.S. interest rates into those caused by changes in inflation expectations (“inflation” shocks), changes in perceptions of the Federal Reserve's reaction function (“reaction” shocks), and changes in real activity (“real” shocks). Our analysis attributes the sharp increases in U.S. interest rates since early 2022 mainly to inflation and, especially, reaction shocks. These types of shocks are associated with adverse effects: EMDE financial conditions tighten, consumption and investment fall, and governments cut spending to improve budget balances. By comparison, rising U.S. interest rates stemming from real shocks are not only associated with benign outcomes for EMDE financial conditions but also improvements in budget balances that reflect higher revenues as well as lower expenditures. Finally, this paper documents that rising U.S. interest rates driven by reaction shocks are especially likely to push EMDEs into a financial crisis.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了美国不同类型利率冲击对新兴市场和发展中经济体（EMDEs）的影响。我们首先将美国利率变动分类为因通胀预期变化引起的“通胀”冲击、因对美联储反应函数认知变化引起的“反应”冲击，以及因实际经济活动变化引起的“实际”冲击。我们的分析将自2022年初以来美国利率的急剧上升主要归因于通胀冲击，尤其是反应冲击。这类冲击伴随着不利影响：EMDEs金融状况收紧，消费和投资下降，政府削减支出以改善预算平衡。相比之下，源于实际冲击的美国利率上升不仅与EMDEs金融状况的良性结果相关，还伴随着预算平衡的改善，这反映了收入增加和支出减少。最后，本文指出，由反应冲击驱动的美国利率上升尤其可能将EMDEs推向金融危机。

title: Ordinary Life Insurance: The Best-Performing Financial Asset of the 1930s
title_zh: 普通人寿保险：20世纪30年代表现最佳的金融资产
title_primary: 普通人寿保险：20世纪30年代表现最佳的金融资产
title_secondary: Ordinary Life Insurance: The Best-Performing Financial Asset of the 1930s
authors: Vellore Arthi, Gary Richardson, Mark Van Orden
official: 官方在线 2025-10-25 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: From 1900 to 1940, ordinary working- and middle-class families saved for retirement and contingencies via ordinary life insurance policies. These policies combined insurance and savings in a single financial instrument that paid its face value to insured individuals who survived until maturity and to beneficiaries if the insured died before the maturity date. The popularity of these policies peaked before WWII when a substantial share of all households and most of the middle class invested in them. This paper explains why these policies were the most popular savings vehicle of their day. Ordinary life policies were well suited to the early twentieth-century economic environment. They had good returns; low risks; tax advantages; and little correlation with returns of competing investments, like bank deposits, building and loan shares, postal savings deposits, real estate, or stocks. The policies protected households from poverty in old age, from the premature death of their breadwinner, and from other risks including disability and deflation. Understanding how households saved in the past has implications for a wide range of literatures in the social sciences.
abstract_zh: 1900年至1940年间，普通工薪阶层与中产家庭通过普通人寿保险为退休生活及意外风险进行储蓄。这类保单将保险与储蓄功能整合于单一金融工具中：若投保人存活至保单到期日，可领取面值金额；若投保人在到期日前身故，则赔付给受益人。二战前，这类保单的普及度达到顶峰，当时相当比例的家庭及大多数中产阶级均持有此类投资。本文旨在阐释为何这类保单能成为当时最受欢迎的储蓄工具。普通人寿保险完美契合了20世纪初的经济环境：其兼具高回报率、低风险、税收优惠，且与银行存款、建房贷款协会股份、邮政储蓄存款、房地产或股票等竞争性投资的收益率相关性极低。此类保单不仅保障家庭免于老年贫困、家庭支柱早逝风险，还能抵御残疾及通货紧缩等其他风险。理解历史上的家庭储蓄模式，对社会科学领域的诸多文献具有重要启示意义。

title: Seasonality and growth in the generalized bioeconomic model
title_zh: 广义生物经济模型中的季节性与增长
title_primary: 广义生物经济模型中的季节性与增长
title_secondary: Seasonality and growth in the generalized bioeconomic model
authors: Yuanming Ni, Arnt O. Hopland, Sturla F. Kvamsdal
official: 官方在线 2025-10-18 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Seasonality is a fundamental environmental feature of many resource industries such as fisheries, and growth can be characterized in different ways. Both seasonality and growth are important to understand and model to support efficient management. The generalized Gordon–Schaefer model for microdata has been promoted with implications for policy and considers the effects of gear and fishing area on productivity. We extend this model with seasonal adjustments and alternative growth specifications. Using trip-level landing data and satellite tracking of vessels, we apply this model to the Norwegian cod fishery. The model is estimated in two stages: In the first stage, we estimate a production function with season-, area-, gear-, and time-fixed effects. From this stage, we extract an estimate of stock abundance. In the second stage, we use stock as the dependent variable and estimate several stock growth equations. The estimated stock abundance and maximum sustainable yield, an important policy benchmark, compare well with established stock assessments and related harvest advice. However, growth specifications have substantial impacts on policy implications.
abstract_zh: 季节性是多类资源产业（如渔业）的基本环境特征，而增长则可通过多种方式加以刻画。理解并建模季节性与增长对于支持高效管理至关重要。广义Gordon–Schaefer微观数据模型已被推广，并具有政策含义，同时考虑了渔具和捕捞区域对生产力的影响。我们对该模型进行了扩展，加入了季节性调整及替代性增长设定。利用航次层面的上岸数据和船舶卫星追踪信息，我们将该模型应用于挪威鳕鱼渔业。模型分两阶段估计：第一阶段，我们估计包含季节、区域、渔具及时间固定效应的生产函数，并从中提取资源丰度的估计值；第二阶段，以资源丰度为因变量，估计多种资源增长方程。所估计的资源丰度及最大可持续产量（一项重要的政策基准）与既有资源评估及相关捕捞建议吻合良好。然而，增长设定对政策含义具有显著影响。

title: Fiscal capacity, incentives for R&D, and firm innovation
title_zh: 财政能力、研发激励与企业创新
title_primary: 财政能力、研发激励与企业创新
title_secondary: Fiscal capacity, incentives for R&D, and firm innovation
authors: Chen Zou, Xiaoyong Dai, Hao Shen
official: 官方在线 2025-09-17 · 来源：RSS
abstract: While fiscal incentives are widely used to promote firm innovation, their effectiveness is inherently constrained by local governments’ fiscal capacity – a factor surprisingly overlooked in existing research. This oversight is particularly critical in multi-level governance systems, where centrally designed policies are implemented by fiscally heterogeneous local governments. Leveraging city-level variations in China, we examine how municipal fiscal capacity shapes the implementation of fiscal incentives and, ultimately, firm innovation. We find that cities with stronger fiscal capacity implement R&D subsidies and tax incentives more comprehensively, leading to significantly better innovation outcomes – especially for high-tech firms and non-state-owned enterprises. Our findings underscore the importance of addressing the disparities in local fiscal capacity to enhance policy implementation and effectiveness.
abstract_zh: 尽管财政激励被广泛用于促进企业创新，但其实效性本质上受制于地方政府的财政能力——这一因素在现有研究中出人意料地被忽视了。这一疏漏在多层治理体系中尤为关键，因为中央设计的政策由财政能力各异的地方政府执行。利用中国城市层面的差异，我们考察了市级财政能力如何影响财政激励的实施，并最终影响企业创新。我们发现，财政能力较强的城市更全面地实施研发补贴和税收激励，从而带来显著更优的创新成果——尤其对高科技企业和非国有企业而言。我们的研究结果强调了解决地方财政能力差异以提升政策执行与效果的重要性。
